vector-v1.description: Original chunks, BGE cosine search, top five.

catalogue-v1.description: Extracted passages, BGE search, top five; no category filtering.

category-v1.description: Earlier strict category-filtered evidence search with stored graph links.

agentic-v2.description: Fresh hybrid search, soft categories, Qwen reranking, section lookup and bounded follow-up.

sentence-selection-v1.description: Select exact sentence/clauses from FIXED saved agentic evidence, reading full paragraph context.

domain-ontology-v1.description: Source-only full-domain extraction for ten short agreements; bounded graph-only agent and cited answer, followed by evidence evaluation.

domain-deepseek-v1.description: DeepSeek extraction with existing design, plus expanded relationships on fixed base nodes; same local query agent.

domain-deepseek-v2.description: DeepSeek-only graph querying and answering over fixed B/C graphs; no local Qwen runtime.

domain-deepseek-v3.description: 20 randomly selected additional agreements, all benchmark questions, frozen DeepSeek-only settings and failure-inclusive metrics.
